"""Heuristic classification of unknown ComfyUI node names.

The auditor inspects node names for suspicious substrings and assigns a
verdict. Existing categories (network I/O) are unchanged; a new
"net-exec" category flags nodes whose names suggest code execution,
agent tooling, or remote inference services.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AuditVerdict:
    """Result of auditing a single node name."""

    node_name: str
    category: str | None
    reason: str | None

    @property
    def flagged(self) -> bool:
        return self.category is not None


# Existing categories: preserved exactly so current fixture verdicts
# (category names and reason strings) do not change.
_HTTP_PATTERN = re.compile(r"http", re.IGNORECASE)
_HTTP_REASON = "node name references raw HTTP handling"

_REQUEST_PATTERN = re.compile(r"request", re.IGNORECASE)
_REQUEST_REASON = "node name references outbound requests"

_DOWNLOAD_PATTERN = re.compile(r"download", re.IGNORECASE)
_DOWNLOAD_REASON = "node name references downloading content"

# New category: net-exec. Flags exec/eval/interpose/agent/inference
# service style node names that previously evaded classification.
_NET_EXEC_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"exec|eval|interpose|agent|inference[-_ ]?service",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_NET_EXEC_REASON = "node name suggests code execution or agent/inference service invocation"

_CATEGORIES = (
    (_HTTP_PATTERN, "http", _HTTP_REASON),
    (_REQUEST_PATTERN, "request", _REQUEST_REASON),
    (_DOWNLOAD_PATTERN, "download", _DOWNLOAD_REASON),
    (_NET_EXEC_PATTERN, "net-exec", _NET_EXEC_REASON),
)


def audit_node_name(node_name: str) -> AuditVerdict:
    """Classify a node name by regex heuristics.

    Existing http/request/download verdicts are unchanged; names that
    previously passed unflagged may now be flagged as "net-exec".
    """
    for pattern, category, reason in _CATEGORIES:
        if pattern.search(node_name):
            return AuditVerdict(
                node_name=node_name, category=category, reason=reason
            )
    return AuditVerdict(node_name=node_name, category=None, reason=None)


def audit_nodes(node_names: list[str]) -> list[AuditVerdict]:
    """Audit a batch of node names."""
    return [audit_node_name(name) for name in node_names]

"""Tests for the net-exec category in the node auditor."""

from comfyui_mcp.security.node_auditor import audit_node_name


def test_agent_node_flagged_by_net_exec():
    verdict = audit_node_name("MyAgentTool")
    assert verdict.flagged
    assert verdict.category == "net-exec"


def test_net_exec_patterns_flagged():
    for name in ("ExecAnything", "EvalNode", "InterposeBridge", "InferenceService"):
        verdict = audit_node_name(name)
        assert verdict.flagged, name
        assert verdict.category == "net-exec", name


def test_existing_fixture_classifications_unchanged():
    assert audit_node_name("HttpFetcher").category == "http"
    assert audit_node_name("RequestSender").category == "request"
    assert audit_node_name("DownloadHelper").category == "download"
    assert audit_node_name("PlainImageBlur").category is None


def test_net_exec_reason_string_appears():
    verdict = audit_node_name("MyAgentTool")
    assert verdict.reason == (
        "node name suggests code execution or agent/inference service invocation"
    )
